meaning:
παρα-σκευάζω
[in LXX: Jer.50:42 (עָרַךְ), etc. ;]
to prepare, make ready: absol. (sc. τ. δεῖπνον, etc.; of. Hdt., ix, 82, 2Ma.2:27), Act.10:10; mid., to prepare, make preparations: 1Co.14:8 (cf. Je, l.with); pass., 2Co.9:2-3.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.
For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up…
